title.zh: 币安在巴西限制服务并下架代币以符合央行新规
title.en: Binance to Restrict 8 Services and Delist 22 Tokens in Brazil to Comply With New

current_state.zh: Binance 已对巴西用户限制八项服务并下架 22 种代币，以应对该国的监管与合规要求，收紧其本地业务。
current_state.en: Binance has restricted eight services and delisted 22 tokens for users in Brazil, tightening its local offering in response to the country's regulatory and compliance requirements.

updates.title_zh: Binance 将在巴西限制 8 项服务并下架 22 种代币以遵守新规
updates.title_en: Binance to Restrict 8 Services and Delist 22 Tokens in Brazil to Comply With New
updates.what_changed_zh: Binance 将从 10 月 27 日起对巴西用户限制八项服务并停止 22 种代币的交易，并在 10 月 29 日前将其迁移至当地集团实体，以遵守央行新的加密法规。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance will restrict eight services and halt trading in 22 tokens for Brazilian users starting October 27 and migrate them to a local group entity by October 29 to comply with new central bank crypto regulations.
